name: nyc-navigator
comment: Root manifest for the Base44 editor's npm run dev/build/lint/preview checks. The real app lives in web/ (see README/PORTING.md); production is deployed via base44/config.jsonc `site` settings. These scripts delegate to web/ so the editor and the CLI deploy stay in sync without moving the project.

scripts.dev: (test -d web/node_modules || npm --prefix web install --silent) && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build: (test -d web/node_modules || npm --prefix web install --silent) && npm --prefix web run build --
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['web/index.html','web/src/main.tsx','web/package.json','web/vite.config.ts'];const missing=files.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(missing.length){console.error('lint: missing '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('lint: ok (web app source present; vite build is the source of truth)')"
